fields.acceptance: A Go test over the registry fails on a description breaking the style's mechanical rules (capital first letter, no trailing period, defaults written as '; default <x>'), describe-golden is regenerated and TestScripts/describe-golden passes, rhiza docs output is regenerated and go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/docs-reference' passes
fields.statement: Every command, argument and flag description (the desc tags of the request structs) follows one plain style: a capitalised sentence with no trailing period, saying what it does in everyday words, with defaults and choices in one consistent form, so rhiza --help and the generated docs/reference read alike
